schema_extension_requests.rationale: Amass Goblins N is a keyword action combining conditional Army token creation, +1/+1 counter placement, and a Goblin subtype grant on an Army; no single controlled predicate captures the composite action, and there is no shared rule:amass id or mechanic_template for Amass in shared_context. Modeled here via CREATES_OBJECT + ADDS_COUNTER as a workaround.
